verdict.rationale: Replica-skill is a set of Claude Code skills that the user runs manually in sequence, so an event-triggered automation axis is a fair question for it. The evidence documents no way for a user to define rules that fire actions on events. The deploy-blocking sweep is a fixed built-in gate, not user-defined rules. The reminder emails are a feature of the generated clone app, not of this product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
